name: Default — Bo7
author: sunguraa
description: A coin flip decides who starts. Teams pick six maps, then ban one map. The other team picks the side for each picked map. The team that does not ban picks the side for the final map.
notes: Port Euler excluded from Season 3 ranked pool. 1 ban + 6 picks = 7 maps touched, 1 decider. Starts with picks to offset banning team advantage.
